industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: Cortus Energy AB (publ)
summary: Cortus Energy AB (publ) provides renewable energy gas solutions in Sweden. The company offers energy gas based on its WoodRoll patented gasification technology for the steel industry, transport, combined heat and power, and chemical markets. Cortus Energy AB (publ) was founded in 2006 is based in Kista, Sweden.
